meta.name: Bottle detail ASK v6 — grape knowledge, internal and extracted profiles, 300 questions
meta.pass_rule: At least 90% of answers fully correct (grade 2), overall and in each category of 10 or more questions.
meta.notes: Held-out set: do not tune the prompt or Kotlin against it. 150 questions on the internal profiles and 150 on the extracted table (90 answerable, 30 false claims, 15 with no country where Gemma must ask, 15 with a country that has no rows where Kotlin refuses). No invented names. Extracted answers must credit wine enthusiasts and say 'limited evidence' for starred values. Expected rows replicate the app: country + grape spellings, any of body/tannin/acidity, province order, preferred province first, 3 at most. Profiles and keys are evaluation metadata only, never passed to Gemma.
